metadata.source_file: gazebo_truth.jsonl (original PX4/Gazebo X500 recording; not bundled)
metadata.frame_time_definition: frame 1 is t=0; frame 600 is t=599/30; encoded duration is 20 s

coordinates.position_enu: X/Y relative to first source sample; Z remains raw source Z
coordinates.inspire_orientation_formula: orientation_inspire = orientation_xyzw * model_to_flu (+90 degrees Z, right multiplication)
coordinates.body_forward_enu: recorded FLU +X rotated into ENU; unrelated to instantaneous velocity

end_pose_selection.criterion: minimum speed estimated with centred +/-0.25 s position difference
end_pose_selection.reason: source 49 s is descending; closing shot freezes an earlier recorded high-altitude low-motion pose

route_metrics.source_speed_method: adjacent original sample position differences over recorded simulation time
route_metrics.environment_clearance_note: Recorded body-centre route exceeds nominal 2x2 m because of tracking overshoot; allow rotor/body radius plus scene margin outside bounds. No tree collision verification is implied.

presentation_notes: One existing X500 Gazebo/PX4 recording is used; the simulation was not rerun.
Takeoff and cruise use nonuniform time compression (cubic smoothstep source-time mapping).
The closing four seconds repeat one recorded pose; this is an editorial freeze, not a verified four-second hover.
Inspire 3 appearance replaces X500 appearance; the flight is not manufacturer-validated Inspire 3 dynamics.
No position path scaling or invented attitude is applied. Ground contact height is left for scene calibration.

forward_segment_check.note: Direction assessed on moving interior frames; segment boundaries ease to zero speed.
